newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Aug inflation 5.7 pct vs 0.1 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Aug inflation 5.7 pct vs 0.1 pct in July.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation rate rose to 5.7 percent in August after record low levels of 0.1 percent in July and June, the Statistics Ministry said on Thursday.
UKRAINE CONSUMER PRICES AUG 96 JULY 96 AUG 95
Government officials have previously said the August inflation rate would jump to 6-8 percent following a government-ordered price increase in rents and utilities at the beginning of the month.
Deputy Economy Minister Victor Kalnyk said this week that monthly inflation will fall back to 1.5-2 percent in September.
The government ordered a month-long price freeze the day the hryvnya was introduced to prevent businesses from raising prices, but many stores raised prices before the hryvnya's debut.
The ministry does not publish year-on-year figures but said the annual inflation rate in August stood at about 30 percent.
